Голос — это образец: 10–20 секунд записи:
A voice is a sample: 10–20 seconds of recording plus its exact transcript.
A good sample is a single voice with no music or effects and an even delivery: if a calm line sits next to a shout, the synthesis jumps around.
From one character it is better to make two voices, a calm one and an intense one.
Make several variants from different parts of the recording and compare them on the test phrases: they can sound very different.
Аудио до 15 минут и менее 512 МБ.<br> Вы:
Audio up to 15 minutes and under 512 MB.
Select a segment on the waveform with the mouse to add it as a variant.
Mouse wheel zooms; Shift + mouse wheel scrolls; a left click plays from that point.
В расшифровке слово в слово должно быть:
The transcript must match the segment word for word: every word, repetition, “uh”, and a word cut off at the edge.
Punctuation as you hear it: a comma at a pause, a full stop at the end of a sentence, “?” and “!” by intonation.
Numbers and abbreviations as they are spoken: “twenty-five”, not “25”.
Transcript errors can cause bad synthesis: it starts swallowing words, repeating them or adding stray sounds.
Скорость речи голоса во всех фразах. Без:
How fast the voice speaks in every phrase. Without a segment — as in the sample.
Most accurate is a 20–60 second segment of normal speech with a transcript.

LoRA дообучает модель ESpeech на реплика: LoRA fine-tunes the ESpeech model on lines of the voice: the timbre and manner of speech get closer to the original than from a single sample. A minute of lines is enough. Training runs on the synthesis server, on a GPU it takes from a few minutes (about 15 minutes for 3000 steps on an RTX 3060 Ti).
Пока идёт обучение, видеокарта занята им: While training runs, the GPU is busy with it: viewers' TTS keeps working between steps, but slower. Switching the model or device, the speed test, unloading the model and installing voice sets are unavailable meanwhile: they restart the synthesis server. The training result lives in the server's memory until it is saved into the voice — restarting the server or the program discards it.
Реплика — от 0,3 до 30 секунд речи тольк: A line is 0.3 to 30 seconds of speech by this voice only, without music or other voices. The text is exactly what is heard, as for a sample: every word, numbers as words, punctuation by intonation. Stress marks “+” are optional — the model adds them; the Stress button shows how, fix the wrong ones. At least 1 minute of lines (15–20 of them) is recommended.
Пары файлов с одинаковым именем («реплик: Pairs of files with the same name (“line.wav” and “line.txt”) — the text is filled in automatically. From a long recording (up to 15 minutes) lines are cut on the waveform: select a span with the mouse and press “+ Line from selection”. Mouse wheel zooms, Shift + wheel scrolls, a click plays from that point.
Пустое поле — шаги по объёму набора: 100: Leave empty for steps by set size: 1000 per minute of lines, from 500 to 3000 (1 min — 1000, 2 min — 2000, 3 min and more — 3000). A small set overfits with too many steps — then “time to stop” appears.
Тестовые фразы с результатом обучения: «: Test phrases with the training result: “best” is the snapshot at the validation loss minimum, “last” is from the last step; “last” can be played during training too. Compare with the voice without LoRA and save the one that sounds better. The server keeps the previous voice file next to it (.espeech.bak).
